name: Palace of Knossos
implementationGoal: One historically grounded, fully traversable interior route that can be reviewed in the web Interior Lab and then imported into UE5 without redesigning the asset contract.

review.purpose: Interior Lab visual and traversal review

ue5.preferredFormat: FBX or glTF/GLB through validated importer

coordinateContract.upAxis: Z in UE5; convert from glTF Y-up during import
coordinateContract.worldOriginPolicy: room cluster pivot near route entry; never use raw geospatial coordinates inside the playable interior actor

reviewGates: Source license and redistribution terms verified
Room dimensions checked against reliable archaeological/reference material
Player can enter, cross, turn around, and exit every room in pilot route
Grand Staircase can be ascended and descended without teleporting
No obvious holes or one-sided wall failures from playable viewpoints
Mobile review build loads without browser crash
UE5 pilot maintains stable collision and navigation
No historical reconstruction detail is treated as fact when the source is interpretive
notYetApproved: Exact source license for production redistribution
